stage: MQTT nonwaiting physical Client retirement query

contract.ready: logical CLOSED, no requests/startup bytes, last Client notification tail and native Stream retired
contract.pending: active ownership or immediately busy predicate mutex

notes: Full builds have 22 modular tests, 29 single-header tests and six Core examples; the new MQTT example additionally runs against all four actual static/shared packages.
Private single tests hold each existing Client/native predicate mutex and query from self/other worker before releasing it; no ready refcount is fabricated.
A native Stream alias keeps an otherwise retired Client pending. Invalid real Client mutex storage produces ERROR even with an identical old static diagnostic.
Public tests hold logical CLOSED callbacks, run two waiters and exercise both workers; pending/ready budget loops preserve exact old errors with no requested allocation or redelivery.
The Dial single test observes pending asynchronous resolution and ready cancellation before any Stream exists. TLS helpers verify readiness after actual transport retirement.
Four separately compiled controller probes close and observe retirement only through PollRetired, then require WaitFor(Client,0)==OK and query on-worker before external cleanup: 64 total lifecycles.
No wire/protocol semantics changed and independent broker tests were not rerun for this lifecycle-only stage.
Source-level existing hot paths are unchanged. No end-to-end throughput, P99, CPU/RSS, native Linux, >=72h soak or production qualification is inferred.
open_work: automatic reconnect/backoff/jitter/cancellation and bounded generation ownership
offline acceptance, automatic subscription recovery and durable/crash recovery
